study: Abe et al. 2012 — Pacific CHILD PD, REL Pacific cluster RCT (NCEE 2013-4002), grade 4-5 ELA teachers, reading
delivery_evidence: Pacific CHILD delivered ~42 days of PD over 2 years as face-to-face workshop-style annual institutes (10-day) + 3-day mini-institutes, plus monthly in-classroom lesson demonstrations, twice-monthly classroom observations, and weekly on-site learning-team meetings (intervention description, p.~5-6; attendance Tables 4.3-4.4).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome is the SAT-10 Reading Comprehension scale score (Hawai'i: TerraNova converted to SAT-10-equivalent) — a broad nationally-standardized independent achievement test not tailored to the intervention (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Table B.5).
curriculum_evidence: Pacific CHILD is PD that builds teachers' reading-comprehension instructional strategies (vocabulary, text structure, question generation) for use with teachers' existing curriculum — the report repeatedly frames it as implementing core components 'with their existing curriculum'; no new curriculum/materials package adopted (p.~5; RQ wording).
outcome_timing_evidence: Student reading outcome measured spring of Year 2, at the end of the 2-year intervention (extraction timepoint=post, spring Year 2); no later delayed follow-up wave extracted.
